title: forgemirror configuration
description: Configuration file of forgemirror (forgemirror.yaml). Every key can also be set via FORGEMIRROR_* environment variables, so keys such as webhook.secret are not required in the file.

listen_address.description: host:port of the webhook listener (POST /webhook); an empty host listens on all interfaces.

ops_listen_address.description: host:port of the ops listener (/healthz, /readyz, /metrics). Keep it cluster-internal.

read_header_timeout.description: How long a client may take to send the request headers.

shutdown_timeout.description: Upper bound for a graceful shutdown, including running mirrors. Keep it below the Kubernetes terminationGracePeriodSeconds.

ui.description: Read-only web UI (configuration, status, logs). It has no authentication: put a reverse proxy or SSO in front of it.

enabled.description: Serve the web UI. When false, its port is not opened.

listen_address.description: host:port of the web UI listener.

log_entries.description: Number of recent log records kept in memory for the UI.

webhook.description: Webhook endpoint that receives Forgejo push events.

secret.description: Required (here, as secret_file, or via FORGEMIRROR_WEBHOOK__SECRET): the HMAC secret configured on the Forgejo webhook. Mutually exclusive with secret_file.

secret_file.description: File to read webhook.secret from, e.g. a mounted Kubernetes Secret. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Mutually exclusive with secret.

max_body_bytes.description: Maximum accepted request body size in bytes.

source.description: Credentials for cloning from Forgejo. Leave the token empty if only public repositories are mirrored.

base_url.description: URL of the Forgejo instance. Webhook payloads whose clone URL is not below it are rejected, so the token is only ever sent to this host. Empty accepts every clone URL.

username.description: Username sent together with the token.

token.description: Forgejo access token. Mutually exclusive with token_file.

token_file.description: File to read source.token from. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Mutually exclusive with token.

sync.description: What starts a mirror run: push webhooks, a schedule, or both. A schedule needs source.base_url and a source token.

on_push.description: Forgejo push webhooks start runs. Setting this to false requires a schedule. webhook.secret is only required when this is true or a target sets delete.

schedule.description: Interval between scheduled runs over all repositories visible to the source token; 0s disables scheduled runs. The first run starts right after startup.

timeout.description: Upper bound for one clone + push to one target.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum git processes running at once, across all repositories. Forge API steps of typed targets are capped separately by the same number.

git_binary.description: git executable: a name looked up in PATH or an absolute path.

work_dir.description: Directory for temporary clones; empty uses the OS temp directory.

filter.description: Which pushes are mirrored. Every configured rule must pass; without rules every push is mirrored. Patterns are Go regular expressions (RE2) that must match the whole value.

include_repos.description: Only repositories whose "owner/name" matches this pattern are mirrored.

exclude_repos.description: Repositories whose "owner/name" matches this pattern are never mirrored. Wins over include_repos.

include_branches.description: Only pushes to branches matching one of these patterns trigger a mirror. Tag pushes always do.

exclude_private.description: Skip repositories that are private on Forgejo. Only applies with only untyped targets and no sync.schedule; otherwise private repositories are synced only if allow_private matches them.

allow_private.description: With any typed target or a sync.schedule, a private repository is synced only if this pattern matches its "owner/name", and exclude_private has no effect. With only untyped targets and no schedule, matching private repositories pass exclude_private. Private repositories are created and kept private on every target.

require_topic.description: Opt-in: only repositories carrying this Forgejo topic are mirrored. Not an access control: every repository owner can set topics.

targets.description: Forges that receive the mirror. Without a type, target repositories must already exist.

name.description: Unique name of the target, used in logs and metrics.

url.description: Push URL as a Go text/template, rendered per repository with {{ .Owner }}, {{ .Name }} and {{ .FullName }}. http(s) only, without credentials.

username.description: Username sent together with the token; GitHub, Codeberg and GitLab accept oauth2.

token.description: Access token for the target. Exactly one of token and token_file is required.

token_file.description: File to read the target token from. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Exactly one of token and token_file is required.

type.description: Forge API to use for this target. Without a type the target is a plain git push destination and the keys below are not allowed.

api_url.description: API base URL; derived from type and the host of url when empty (github.com uses https://api.github.com, other hosts <host>/api/v3 for GitHub, /api/v4 for GitLab, /api/v1 for Forgejo). Requires type.

create.description: Create the target repository when it is missing. Requires type.

delete.description: Delete the target repository when Forgejo reports the source repository as deleted. Requires type and a webhook secret.

prune_labels.description: Delete labels on the target that do not exist on the source. Deleting a label strips it from every issue and pull request, so this is off by default. Requires type.

settings.description: Target-wide settings that win over the values of the Forgejo repository. Requires type.

overrides.description: Settings for matching repositories, applied in order on top of settings; later entries win. Requires type.

website.description: Repository website; ignored for GitLab, which has no such field.

default_branch.description: Default branch; applied after the first push, because the branch must exist.

private.description: Force the repository to be private on this target. Only true is allowed: a public source can be hidden, a private source can never be exposed.

has_pull_requests.description: Enable pull or merge requests; ignored for GitHub, which cannot disable them.

labels.description: Synchronise labels; false disables label sync for this scope. Defaults to true.

repos.description: Go regular expression (RE2) that must match the whole "owner/name" of the Forgejo repository.
